name: THE UNDERTAKER'S
note: Room 13, doc 20, reached only from the town map. ERRATA 23's named exception to the palette proportions: near-monochrome on purpose, and scrubbed rather than dim. Reached from a map drawn in achromatic pencil grey precisely so a bone map into a bone room is not the adjacency 17b forbids -- step 0 caught it before either existed. Composed to the frozen standard; NO HOTSPOTS YET. The examine layer arrives with the document being written for this room -- a hotspot with no line is worse than no hotspot, and check-examine-lines says so. Every door here is marked stub for the same reason: the destination exists so the exit works and the lines are honestly absent rather than invented.
materialIdentity: Scrubbed bone-white and pine, near-monochrome, deliberately (17b) -- errata 23's named exception to the palette proportions

paletteScript.note: ERRATA 23's proportions and 30f's step 0, committed from renders/interior-identity-plan. Dominant 55-70%, structural shadow 15-25%, secondary local colour 10-15%, narrative accent 3-8%.
